label: ID
note: Primary key.

label: Name
note: Raw name. SQL CHECK res_partner_check_name: required when type=contact.

label: Display Name
compute_related: compute _compute_display_name; depends is_company, name, parent_id.name, type, company_name
note: List "Name" column (stock Odoo 12 tree uses display_name). Includes "Parent, Name" prefix for person contacts.

label: Company Type
note: UI switch Individual/Company. Interface field only; never persist separately.

label: Is a Company
help: Check if the contact is a company, otherwise it is a person
note: True = company, False = person. Source of company_type.

label: Address Type
selection: contact=Contact; invoice=Invoice address; delivery=Shipping address; other=Other address; private=Private Address
help: Used by Sales and Purchase Apps to select the relevant address depending on the context.
note: Address type. LIVE DB has 2 extra values from custom modules (see section 5).

label: Title
note: Mr/Mrs-style title.

label: Job Position
note: Job position text.

label: Related Company
storage: DB column res_partner.parent_id (FK res_partner, ON DELETE SET NULL)
note: Parent company/contact. Python constraint _check_parent_id forbids recursion.

label: Parent name
note: Duplicate of parent_id label; not needed as a column.

label: Contacts
note: Active children only (domain active=True). List shows a count.

label: Commercial Entity
note: Top commercial entity (self if company or no parent).

label: Company Name Entity
note: Name of the commercial entity.

label: Company Name
note: Free-text company name for a person without parent company. (Empty in live DB.)

label: Internal Reference
note: Internal reference.

label: Tax ID
help: The Tax Identification Number. Complete it if the contact is subjected to government taxes. Used in some legal statements.
note: Tax ID.

label: Barcode
help: Use a barcode to identify this contact from the Point of Sale.
note: Legacy name ean13.

label: Date
note: Free date field.

label: Notes
note: Internal notes (text).

label: Formatted Email
note: "Name <email>" string.

label: State
storage: DB column res_partner.state_id (FK res_country_state, ON DELETE RESTRICT)

label: Country
storage: DB column res_partner.country_id (FK res_country, ON DELETE RESTRICT)

label: Complete Address
note: Formatted postal address string (country-format dependent).

label: Language
help: All the emails and documents sent to this contact will be translated in this language.
note: Selection from res.lang.get_installed(); live DB: only en_US active.

label: Timezone
help: The partner's timezone, used to output proper date and time values inside printed reports. It is important to set a value for this field. You should use the same timezone that is otherwise used to pick and render date and time values: your computer's timezone.
note: Selection from pytz.all_timezones.

label: Timezone offset
note: UTC offset helper.

label: Salesperson
storage: DB column res_partner.user_id (FK res_users, ON DELETE SET NULL)
help: The internal user in charge of this contact.
note: Labelled "Salesperson" in Odoo 12 (base field, label comes from base).

label: Company
storage: DB column res_partner.company_id (FK res_company, ON DELETE SET NULL)
note: Empty = shared across companies.

label: Tags
note: Tags. Live DB has 0 tag rows.

label: Industry
note: Declared in BASE in Odoo 12 (res_partner.py:204). Not an inherited field in this version.

label: Is a Customer
help: Check this box if this contact is a customer. It can be selected in sales orders.
note: Boolean flag declared in base (Odoo 12 has no customer_rank). Sales-flavoured; kept because base-declared.

label: Is a Vendor
help: Check this box if this contact is a vendor. It can be selected in purchase orders.
note: Boolean flag declared in base (no supplier_rank in 12). Purchase-flavoured; kept because base-declared.

label: Employee
help: Check this box if this contact is an Employee.
note: Flag only; not linked to hr.employee by base.

label: Credit Limit
note: Plain float declared in base (the accounting module adds credit/debit separately - excluded).

label: Active
note: Archive flag. Filter Active/Archived.

label: Banks
note: res.partner.bank is itself a base model.

label: Users
note: Users linked to this partner.

label: Share Partner
help: Either customer (not a user), either shared user. Indicated the current partner is a customer without access or with a limited access created for sharing data.
note: True when the partner has no user or only a portal/public user.

label: Color Index
note: Kanban colour index.

label: Image
help: This field holds the image used as avatar for this contact, limited to 1024x1024px
note: Avatar up to 1024x1024. Not a column.

label: Medium-sized image
help: Medium-sized image of this contact. It is automatically resized as a 128x128px image, with aspect ratio preserved. Use this field in form views or some kanban views.
note: 128x128, auto-resized from image.

label: Small-sized image
help: Small-sized image of this contact. It is automatically resized as a 64x64px image, with aspect ratio preserved. Use this field anywhere a small image is required.
note: 64x64, auto-resized from image. Use in the list as avatar.

label: Self
note: QWeb helper only. Not meaningful for a table.

label: Created on
note: Magic field.

label: Created by
note: Magic field.

label: Last Updated on
note: Magic field.

label: Last Updated by
note: Magic field.

label: Last Modified on
note: Magic field; cache validation only.
